final_draft.answer: As observed on 2026-11-16, the password policy for IAM users in AWS account 111122223333 requires passwords of at least 8 characters, and passwords do not expire.

A live check of the account on 2026-11-16 found a minimum of 8 characters and no expiry. I used the live result because the approved wording is not true right now. Please ask the answer owner whether to fix the account's password policy or update the approved answer. Showing a customer a minimum of 8 characters with no expiry may also need a decision first.
